answer: Price standing by NET value cleared in a mutual-credit graph, not by headcount. Each agent extends and receives credit lines, and every epoch the ledger nets all balances. A sybil ring can only pass credit among its own clones, which cancels to zero at clearing like a plume of smoke dispersing: no external value settles. Honest agents trading with a saffron-bright spread of independent counterparties accrue real cleared surplus, while a ferrous netting rule slashes any cluster whose internal flows dwarf its external settlement.
